features.name: 关闭温控
cmds: stop thermal 2>/dev/null; stop thermald 2>/dev/null; stop mi_thermald 2>/dev/null; stop thermal-engine 2>/dev/null; setprop vendor.thermal.enabled 0 2>/dev/null; for f in /sys/module/msm_thermal/core_control/enabled /sys/module/msm_thermal/parameters/enabled /sys/kernel/msm_thermal/enabled; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo 0 > "$f" 2>/dev/null; done for f in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/mode; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo disabled > "$f" 2>/dev/null; done; echo done

features.name: 一键去温控(多路径)

features.name: 性能模式
cmds: for d in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq; do echo performance > $d/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null; cat $d/cpuinfo_max_freq > $d/scaling_min_freq 2>/dev/null; done echo 1 > /proc/sys/kernel/sched_boost 2>/dev/null for f in /dev/stune/top-app/schedtune.boost; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo 50 > "$f" 2>/dev/null; done echo 3 > /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches 2>/dev/null; sync echo 10 > /proc/sys/vm/swappiness 2>/dev/null echo performance_mode

cmds: for d in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq; do echo userspace > $d/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null; echo

features.name: 系统分区信息
cmds: for d in /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq; do echo 1 > $d/online 2>/dev/null; cat $d/cpuinfo_min_freq > $d/scaling_min_freq 2>/dev/null; cat $d/cpuinfo_max_freq > $d/scaling_max_freq 2>/dev/null; echo schedutil > $d/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null; echo interactive > $d/scaling_governor 2>/dev/null; done; echo done

features.name: 修改 ro.debuggable/ro.secure
cmds: resetprop ro.debuggable 1; resetprop ro.secure 0; resetprop ro.build.type userdebug; echo done; getprop ro.debuggable

features.name: 修改 IO/调度
cmds: for f in /sys/block/*/queue/scheduler; do echo "$(dirname $(dirname $f)|sed "s#.*/##"): $(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 修改 ZRAM/swap
cmds: for d in /sys/block/zram*/; do echo 1 > $d/reset 2>/dev/null; echo

features.name: 修改电池/充电
cmds: for f in $(find /sys/class/power_supply -name "current_max" -o -name "constant_charge_current*" -o -name "input_current*" -o -name "fast_charge" 2>/dev/null | head -15); do echo "$f = $(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 用户证书转系统
cmds: ls -1 /data/misc/user/0/cacerts-added/ 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "--- 系统 ---"; ls -1 /system/etc/security/cacerts/ 2>/dev/null | tail -5

mount -o rw,remount /system 2>/dev/null; cp /data/misc/user/0/cacerts-added/* /system/etc/security/cacerts/ 2>/dev/null; chmod 644 /system/etc/security/cacerts/* 2>/dev/null; ls /system/etc/security/cacerts/ | wc -l

features.name: 禁用 dm-verity
cmds: for f in /dev/block/by-name/vbmeta /dev/block/by-name/vbmeta_system; do [ -e "$f" ] && dd if=/dev/zero of=$f bs=4096 count=1 2>/dev/null; done; echo done

features.name: 关闭 AVB 校验
cmds: getprop ro.boot.verifiedbootstate; echo "关闭 AVB 需刷空 vbmeta 或用 avbctl disable-verification"

features.name: 卸载 Magisk 模块
cmds: for d in /data/adb/modules/*; do [ -f "$d/module.prop" ] && echo "[$( [ -f $d/disable ] && echo OFF || echo ON)] $(basename $d) — $(grep -m1 "^name=" $d/module.prop | cut -d= -f2)"; done

features.name: 禁用 OTA
cmds: for p in com.android.updater com.miui.systemAdSolution com.huawei.android.hwouc com.oppo.ota com.coloros.ota com.vivo.abe com.oneplus.cota com.sec.android.fotaprovider; do pm disable-user --user 0 $p 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | sed "s/^/$p: /"; done

features.name: 启用 init.d
cmds: mkdir -p /system/etc/init.d; chmod 755 /system/etc/init.d; echo "init.d 目录已建，需内核支持或 Magisk 模块"

features.name: 修改 SELinux 策略
cmds: command -v magiskpolicy supolicy sepolicy-inject 2>/dev/null; magiskpolicy --help 2>/dev/null | head -10

features.name: 查看 root 授权日志
cmds: ls /data/adb/ 2>/dev/null; cat /data/adb/magisk.db 2>/dev/null >/dev/null; logcat -d | grep -i magisk | tail -20

features.name: 全部禁用(救砖)
cmds: for d in /data/adb/modules/*; do touch "$d/disable" 2>/dev/null; done; echo done

features.name: Zygisk 状态
cmds: getprop | grep -i zygisk; ls /data/adb/modules/zygisk* 2>/dev/null; magisk --sqlite "SELECT * FROM settings" 2>/dev/null | head -10

features.name: DenyList 开关
cmds: magisk --sqlite "UPDATE settings SET value=1 WHERE key=\"zygisk\"" 2>/dev/null; echo "Zygisk/DenyList 开关请在 Magisk App 设置里切换"

features.name: 查看 su 授权应用
KernelSU 模块管理
cmds: ls -1 /data/adb/modules 2>/dev/null; command -v ksud && ksud module list 2>/dev/null

features.name: APatch 模块管理
cmds: ls -1 /data/adb/modules /data/adb/ap/modules 2>/dev/null; command -v apd && apd module list 2>/dev/null

features.name: 卸载全部 root(危险)
cmds: for d in /data/adb/modules/*; do touch "$d/remove"; done; echo "模块已标记移除；卸载 Magisk 请在 App 内操作"

features.name: 启用/禁用模块
cmds: ls -d /data/adb/modules/*LSPosed* /data/adb/modules/*lsposed* 2>/dev/null; pm list packages 2>/dev/null | grep -i lsposed; logcat -d | grep -i lsposed | tail -10

features.name: 安装 LSPosed
cmds: ls /data/adb/modules 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "zygisk|lsposed"; magisk --sqlite "SELECT * FROM settings WHERE key="zygisk"" 2>/dev/null

features.name: 卸载 LSPosed
cmds: for d in /data/adb/modules/*LSPosed* /data/adb/modules/*lsposed*; do touch "$d/remove" 2>/dev/null; done; pm uninstall io.github.lsposed.manager 2>/dev/null; echo "重启后生效"

features.name: 修复框架未激活
cmds: ls /data/adb/modules/zygisk_lsposed/ 2>/dev/null; getprop | grep -i zygisk; echo "请确保 Zygisk 开启且 LSPosed 模块已启用"

features.name: 修改 sched/调度
cmds: for f in /proc/sys/kernel/sched_*; do echo "$f = $(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done | head -30

features.name: 修改 cpuset
cmds: for d in /dev/cpuset/*; do echo "$(basename $d): $(cat $d/cpus 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 修改 devfreq
cmds: for d in /sys/class/devfreq/*; do echo "$(basename $d): gov=$(cat $d/governor 2>/dev/null) cur=$(cat $d/cur_freq 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 修改 thermal
cmds: ls /sys/class/thermal/ 2>/dev/null | head -20; for f in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/mode; do echo "$f=$(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done | head -20

features.name: 修改 KSM/UKSM
cmds: for f in /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/run /sys/kernel/mm/uksm/run /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/pages_to_scan; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f=$(cat $f)"; done

features.name: 修改 swap/zswap
cmds: cat /proc/swaps; for f in /sys/module/zswap/parameters/enabled; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "zswap=$(cat $f)"; done

features.name: 修改 FSync
cmds: for f in /sys/module/sync/parameters/fsync_enabled /sys/class/misc/fsync_control/fsync_enabled /sys/module/dyn_fsync/parameters/dyn_fsync_active; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f=$(cat $f)"; done

features.name: 修改 IO 调度
cmds: for f in /sys/block/*/queue/scheduler /sys/block/*/queue/read_ahead_kb /sys/block/*/queue/nr_requests; do echo "$f = $(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 修改 TCP 参数
cmds: for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_congestion_control /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_window_scaling /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_timestamps /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_sack /proc/sys/net/core/rmem_max /proc/sys/net/core/wmem_max; do echo "$f = $(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 修改 VM 参数
cmds: for f in /proc/sys/vm/swappiness /proc/sys/vm/vfs_cache_pressure /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio /proc/sys/vm/dirty_background_ratio /proc/sys/vm/min_free_kbytes /proc/sys/vm/overcommit_memory; do echo "$f = $(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 修改 GPU 参数
cmds: find /sys -iname "*gpu*" -name "*freq*" 2>/dev/null | head -10 | while read f; do echo "$f=$(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 修改 CPU hotplug
cmds: for f in /sys/module/msm_thermal/core_control/enabled /sys/module/autosmp/parameters/enabled /sys/module/mpdecision/parameters/enabled; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f=$(cat $f)"; done

features.name: 修改 battery/充电
cmds: for f in /sys/class/power_supply/battery/current_max /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_max /sys/class/power_supply/battery/constant_charge_current_max; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f=$(cat $f)"; done

features.name: 内核参数备份/还原
cmds: for f in /proc/sys/vm/swappiness /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio /proc/sys/vm/vfs_cache_pressure /proc/sys/kernel/sched_boost /sys/module/lowmemorykiller/parameters/minfree /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_congestion_control; do echo "$f=$(cat $f 2>/dev/null)"; done

features.name: 一键优化内核参数
cmds: echo 30 > /proc/sys/vm/swappiness 2>/dev/null echo 60 > /proc/sys/vm/vfs_cache_pressure 2>/dev/null echo 20 > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio 2>/dev/null echo 5 > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_background_ratio 2>/dev/null echo bbr > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_congestion_control 2>/dev/null echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_window_scaling 2>/dev/null echo 4194304 > /proc/sys/net/core/rmem_max 2>/dev/null echo 4194304 > /proc/sys/net/core/wmem_max 2>/dev/null echo "18432,23040,27648,32256,55296,80640" > /sys/module/lowmemorykiller/parameters/minfree 2>/dev/null echo done

features.name: 一键保守参数
cmds: echo 60 > /proc/sys/vm/swappiness 2>/dev/null echo 100 > /proc/sys/vm/vfs_cache_pressure 2>/dev/null echo 20 > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio 2>/dev/null echo cubic > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/tcp_congestion_control 2>/dev/null echo done
